_note: TEMPLATE. Copy to redaction.json (gitignored) and fill in terms for YOUR source repository. Pass a different file with --redaction <path> to sanitize a different codebase. A populated deny list is a concentrated index of exactly what you are removing, which is why the real one never ships.
_lesson: The first version of this file listed only customer and company names. It passed its own scan while the fixtures still carried internal audit IDs, a named competitor, module paths, and product strategy written in code comments. A deny list only finds what you already thought of — enumerate what is actually in your files before trusting it.
_comment_scrub: Two levels. A LINE marker removes that line and its continuations, for incident narration. A BLOCK marker removes the whole comment, for product and competitive reasoning — removing one line there leaves a fragment that still carries the point.
strip_comment_blocks: the common case for a non-classes org
